summary: Verified bug fix for Home page TypeError ('i.slice(...).map is not a function'). Home page loads cleanly in production with 0 console/page errors. Array.isArray guards are correctly in place in Home.jsx at line 37 (fetch normalization) and line 103 (render). Hero input, 7 category chips, 6 section see-all links, and 96 product cards all render. Category chip navigation and hero search both work without white screens.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx Array.isArray guards implemented correctly on both fetch (line 37) and render (line 103) paths — resilient to array or {items:[]} shape or any degenerate response.

Minor observation: category and search result pages returned small body text lengths (654 and 389 chars) in the smoke-check — no errors and no white screen, but main agent may want to verify these pages render populated content in a follow-up iteration (out of scope for this bug-fix regression).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 confirmed the Home.jsx TypeError white-screen bug is fixed. Guards present at Home.jsx L37 and L103. If regressing in future, keep Array.isArray defensive checks on any r.data-consuming .map/.slice call.
rca of the issue: RCA: Home.jsx previously called .slice(0,4).map on sections[key] directly assuming the API always returned an array. In production one or more of /api/products/{trending|ai-picks|best-value|price-drops|new} could return a non-array (e.g. {items:[...]} envelope, null, or error object), causing 'i.slice(...).map is not a function' at Home.jsx:107 and a white screen. Mitigation: normalize response in the fetch effect (Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : []) AND defensive extraction in render before .slice().map(). Both are now in place and verified via Playwright with console-error capture — 0 TypeErrors observed.
